description: This file defines the ContactsBinary class, which represents a binary expression node for regex 'matches' operation in Twig's abstract syntax tree. It handles regex validation, compilation of the node into PHP code, and integrates with Twig's compiler infrastructure.

classes.name: MatchesBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression for regex pattern matching within Twig's AST, handling validation and compilation of regex matches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the node with left and right operands, validates regex if right is a constant, and handles syntax errors.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for evaluating the regex match expression.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator string, which is empty in this implementation.
